description: This file defines a PHP class 'sysinfo' that extends 'bsd_common' to gather system information specific to NetBSD, including network statistics, IDE device info, system uptime, and distro icon. It contains class methods, properties, and external program calls.

classes.name: sysinfo
classes.description: A class for retrieving system information on NetBSD systems, including network, disk, and uptime metrics.

methods.name: sysinfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing regular expressions and calling parent constructor.

methods.name: get_sys_ticks
methods.description: Calculates system uptime in seconds based on system boot time.

methods.name: network
methods.description: Retrieves network interface statistics such as bytes, packets, errors, and drops.

methods.name: ide
methods.description: Gathers IDE device information such as model, capacity, and media type from dmesg output.

methods.name: distroicon
methods.description: Returns the filename of the icon representing the distribution, here 'NetBSD.png'.
